## About
We're a collision repair shop on Rock Hill Road in Jamaica Plain, just minutes from Brookline and Boston. We work on all makes and models, and we know that if you're here, you've probably just had a rough experience with your car.
That's why we put communication first. Our staff will answer your questions and explain each step of the repair until it all makes sense. We try to treat everyone like they have a friend in the business.
We've invested in a new spray booth and switched to water-based paints, so your car gets a quality finish with less harm to the environment. We're rated 4.7 from 52 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to earn yours.

## Services
- Collision repair: Body work and repairs for vehicles damaged in an accident, for all makes and models.
- Painting with water-based paints: Paint work using water-based paints for a high quality finish.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call for a free estimate.

Q: Do you work on my kind of car?
A: We service all makes and models.

Q: Will you explain what my repair involves?
A: Yes. We walk you through the repair process step by step until you clearly understand everything it involves.
